345-8095--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creature's creature types is chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

1978-2364-7714.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Mana Vault that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Mana Vault token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Mana Vault token.
Repeat from step 5.

1368-5477-6321-7730.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5477-6321-7730.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4091-5921-5970-7730.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4377-4499-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Emiel the Blessed.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-3899-4552-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

465-2150-2511.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-4681-5170-6094.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1354-2404-2757-5094.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
1354-2404-2757-5094.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {3}{G}{G}, creating a creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.

2034-3330-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3330-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2468-2751-4045.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Ur-Golem's Eye and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1283-6867.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken nonland permanent.
1170-1283-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {4}.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Appa trigger, exiling Chromatic Orrery with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Chromatic Orrery from exile by paying {2}.
Displacer Kitten and Appa trigger.
Resolve the Appa trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Appa.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling another nonland permanent with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast the permanent from exile by paying {2}.
Displacer Kitten and Appa's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Appa trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.
1170-1283-6867.notes: If mana allows, you can instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability.

783-934-1399-1606.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Jungle Basin.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

608-2022-2034-3000-5495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
It is your turn.
608-2022-2034-3000-5495.description:
Activate Thallid Soothsayer by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card.
An opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Xyris's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1737-4853-5004-5686.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

465-719-3742-4251-5223.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-3742-4251-5223.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

673-1621-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
673-1621-4605.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

428-804-1694-3174.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
428-804-1694-3174.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

3480-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
3480-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

2104-5913-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak each turn.
2104-5913-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Pinnacle Monk from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1140-1636-3143-6172.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-6172.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Sunspring Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Sunspring Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

333-2034-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2034-5617.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos, adding {C}{C}.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Repeat.

539-2034-3703-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ashaya from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

191-1689-4067.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
191-1689-4067.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping target permanent you control.
Repeat.

1562-2084.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm, except it is an artifact and not a creature.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {1}{U}, shuffling it into your library and then milling your entire library due to there not being a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1912-2816-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Codie.
1912-2816-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Codie by paying {1} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

75-3020-4050.notablePrerequisites: Puppeteer Clique does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
75-3020-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique, adding {B/G}.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting target creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Puppeteer Clique, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
You may also sacrifice the creature put under your control by Puppeteer Clique during each iteration to get infinite colored mana.

2054-3784-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
2054-3784-4222.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

647-2517-2822-3765.description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, returning Kediss and Bloodswarn Steward from exile to the battlefield.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Kediss.
The opponent dealt damage loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Kediss triggers, dealing damage equal to the combat damage dealt to each other opponent.
Each other opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.

914-4499.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
914-4499.notes: If opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite mana and Treasure tokens.
